abstract: OBJECTIVE: Germ cell tumours are the most common ovarian neoplasms in childhood and, of these, teratomas, whether mature or immature, are the most frequently found. Mature teratoma is a benign tumour, whereas the immature type, although also benign, has a more aggressive course, with a propensity to recurrence. A review of the literature revealed that there are some imaging features that may help to differentiate between these 2 types of teratoma, although no systematic comparison has been made. The objective of this study was to review imaging features of ovarian teratomas in children and to assess differentiating imaging features between the mature and immature types of ovarian teratoma. METHODS: Retrospective analysis of all patients who presented to our institution during a 9-year period (September 1999 to August 2008) with ovarian teratoma as confirmed on histology. RESULTS: Forty-one patients with pathologically proven ovarian teratoma were found. The patient ages ranged from 4-18 years at presentation (mean [standard deviation] age, 12.4 +/- 3.4 years; median age, 13 years). Thirty patients (73.2%) were found to have mature ovarian teratoma, and 11 (26.8%) had immature teratoma. A component of endodermal sinus tumour was found in one of the immature teratomas. On ultrasonography, the appearance of the immature teratomas was purely solid in 3 (27.3%), mixed solid and cystic in 6 (54.5%), and predominantly cystic in 2 (18%). The mature ovarian teratomas demonstrated a predominantly cystic appearance in 22 (73.3%) and a mixed solid and cystic appearance in 8 (26.6%); there were no cases with a pure solid appearance. The prevalence of the more cystic appearance of the mature type showed significant statistical difference when compared with its prevalence in the immature type (P = .0008, chi(2) test). Other imaging features, such as size, presence of fat, or calcifications, did not show a significant difference between the 2 types of teratoma. CONCLUSIONS: The predominance of a cystic component and a pure solid component in ovarian teratoma are significant differentiating factors between the mature type and the more aggressive immature type of teratoma.
abstract_ja: 目的：小児の卵巣奇形腫の画像所見をレビューし、成熟型と未熟型を鑑別する有用な画像所見を検討すること。背景：胚細胞腫瘍は小児の卵巣腫瘍として最も多く、そのなかでは成熟型・未熟型を問わず奇形腫が最も多く見られる。成熟奇形腫は良性であるが、未熟奇形腫も良性とされる一方で、より攻撃的な経過をたどり再発しやすい。文献レビューでは両者を鑑別する画像所見があるとされるが、系統的な比較は行われていない。方法：1999年9月から2008年8月までの9年間に当施設を受診し、組織学的に卵巣奇形腫と確定された患者を後方視的に解析した。結果：病理学的に確認された卵巣奇形腫の患者41例が見つかった。診断時の年齢は4〜18歳(平均12.4±3.4歳、中央値13歳)であった。30例(73.2%)が成熟奇形腫、11例(26.8%)が未熟奇形腫であった。未熟奇形腫の1例では卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分が認められた。超音波検査では、未熟奇形腫は純粋な充実性が3例(27.3%)、充実性と嚢胞性の混在が6例(54.5%)、嚢胞優位が2例(18%)であった。成熟奇形腫は嚢胞優位が22例(73.3%)、充実性と嚢胞性の混在が8例(26.6%)で、純粋な充実性は認められなかった。嚢胞優位の頻度は、成熟型と未熟型で有意差があった(P=.0008、χ²検定)。腫瘍径、脂肪の存在、石灰化などその他の画像所見は両型で有意差がなかった。結論：卵巣奇形腫において嚢胞成分の優位性と純粋な充実性成分の有無は、成熟型と侵襲性の高い未熟型を区別する有意な因子である。
